podcast.body: Billy Joe Armstrong wrote "American Idiot" after the US interventions in Iraq and Afghanistan and the extensive cable news coverage of those wars. The fuse was lit when he heard a Lynyrd Skynyrd song called "That's How I Like It," which celebrates Southern country nationalism. He folded in all the other things he was angry about — blind nationalism, big media, the Iraq War — and the result won four Grammys in 2005 and became the title track of an album that has sold around 25 million copies. "His thought was, wait, this guy is singing about how proud he is to be a redneck? Sure, enjoy your truck and your Budweiser, but this blind nationalism is insane."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
